title: Graduate Engineer Trainee - Software
description: Campus hiring for 2025/26 graduates. Programming fundamentals in Java, Python or C, DBMS and SQL, object-oriented programming. Good communication and willingness to relocate. Training provided.

title: Systems Engineer
description: Freshers with strong logical reasoning, problem solving and coding basics in Java or Python. Write clean code, debug and test applications, work in agile teams.

title: Project Engineer
description: Develop and maintain applications. Required: Java or Python, SQL, basics of cloud. Preferred: certifications in AWS or Azure. Adaptability for large-scale projects.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description: Work on client projects using Java, JavaScript and cloud platforms. Communication skills and business awareness required. Knowledge of Agile and Git is preferred.

title: Programmer Analyst Trainee
description: Freshers with programming skills in Java or .NET, SQL and data structures. Analyse requirements, write code and unit tests. Shift flexibility expected.

title: Software Engineer - Backend (Python)
description: Build payment APIs at scale. Required: Python or Go, REST API design, SQL databases, data structures and algorithms. Preferred: Docker, Kubernetes, distributed systems. Ownership of shipped features.

title: Frontend Engineer (React)
description: Craft delightful product experiences. Required: JavaScript, React, HTML, CSS, responsive design. Preferred: TypeScript, performance optimisation, design sensibility.

title: Software Development Engineer Intern
description: 6-month internship. Work on real features with Java or Kotlin, REST APIs and SQL. Strong DSA and problem solving. Stipend provided.

title: Android Developer Intern
description: Build Android features in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and REST APIs. Projects on GitHub preferred. Fast-paced startup environment.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description: Analyse product data with SQL, Python (pandas) and Excel; build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI. Curiosity and clear communication.

title: Software Engineer - Platform
description: Design developer tools used by millions. Required: JavaScript / Node.js, REST and GraphQL APIs, testing. Preferred: open-source contributions, cloud (AWS).

title: Machine Learning Engineer (Fresher)
description: Build ML models for recommendations. Required: Python, machine learning, NLP or deep learning basics, SQL. Preferred: TensorFlow or PyTorch, MLOps.

title: Associate Consultant - Technology
description: Analytical thinking, communication and business sense. Exposure to SQL, Excel, Python or SAP preferred. Client-facing work and documentation.

title: Software Engineer
description: Strong data structures and algorithms, problem solving, C++ / C# / Java. Design scalable systems, write high-quality code and tests. Internships or projects with impact preferred.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description: Automotive embedded software. Required: C, C++, microcontrollers, RTOS basics. Preferred: AUTOSAR, CAN protocol. ECE/EEE graduates welcome.

title: Design Engineer - Embedded
description: Embedded C, Linux, device driver basics. Preferred: Python scripting, testing tools. Good fundamentals in electronics and programming.

title: Software Engineer Trainee
description: Java, Spring Boot, SQL and web basics. Preferred: React or Angular, cloud certification. Learn quickly and work in product teams.

title: Associate Software Engineer
description: Python or Java development, REST APIs, Git. Preferred: cloud, DevOps tools, IoT exposure. Team player with good communication.

title: Research Intern - NLP (Unpaid)
description: Volunteer research internship on Indian-language NLP. Python, NLP libraries (spaCy, transformers), reading research papers. Certificate and recommendation letter; no stipend.

title: Full Stack Developer Intern
description: React, Node.js or Java backend, SQL, REST APIs. Build features for millions of investors. Stipend provided.

title: Junior Backend Developer
description: Java, Spring Boot, microservices, SQL/NoSQL. Preferred: Kafka, Redis. Ownership and on-call readiness.

title: Technical Support Engineer
description: Troubleshooting, Linux basics, SQL, networking fundamentals, customer communication. Shift-based role.

title: Quality Engineer (Testing)
description: Manual and automation testing, Selenium or Appium, Python or Java scripting, writing test cases, defect tracking.

title: Product Analyst Intern (Unpaid)
description: Help analyse user feedback and product metrics. Excel, SQL basics, communication. Learning-focused unpaid internship with certificate.
